label: text
text: " No Illicit Interference With Foreigners."

label: text
text: The following letter from Mr. Chen Yu-jen, Acting Minister for Foreign Affairs, to the British Consul-General in Canton, Mr. J. F. Brennan, has been issued for publication.

label: text
text: Canton, Oct. 29.

label: text
text: With reference to my letter transmitting the examination regulations "promulgated" by the Ministry of Finance for the examination of the goods of passengers on all outgoing and incoming learners in Canton and district, I would point out that the object of these regulations is to prevent bad characters and enemy agents entering Canton.

label: text
text: This "measure is" of particular importance whilst the northern campaign is going on but it will be cancelled as soon as hostilities have ceased.

label: text
text: Instructions are now being issued by the Government that there must be no illicit interference with foreigners or their baggage.

label: text
text: Provided there is no suspicion of "smuggling arms, etc., into Kwangtung, there will be no need to earn out an examination.

label: text
text: These regulations are in no way designed to duplicate the functions of the Maritime Customs nor is there any intention to use them in order to interfere with the Customs administration.

label: paragraph_title
text: CHINESE PAY.

label: text
text:
Surtaxes Not Collected From
Foreigners

label: text
text: From an authentic source the "China Mail" learns that although the Inspection Corps of the Canton Finance Ministry was announced to function as from yesterday, there has been no attempt to collect the special taxes from foreign merchants.

label: text
text: There is no relaxation of measures to make the native merchants pay.

label: text
text: In the case of exports, the Chinese dealer satisfies the Bureau first before shipment.

label: text
text: Where imported merchandise is received direct by Chinese, the surtax is paid at once. On lots consigned to foreign merchants, the ultimate Chinese buyer pays the special levy when he takes delivery.

label: text
text: The greater majority of Chinese merchants are paying as a matter of course and raising no objection.

Crown Prince & Princess

label: paragraph_title
text: ARRIVE NOV. 20.

label: paragraph_title
text: Informal Visit on Tour of

label: text
text: The Colony will entertain distinguished visitors later in the month in the persons of two members of the Royal House of Sweden, Crown Prince Gustavus Adolphus and Crown Princess Louise.

label: text
text: The royal visitors are passing through the Colony on their first tour of the Orient and whilst in Japan they travelled officially, it is understood that their visit here is an informal one. They pass through on the s.s. "Katori Maru" on the 20th of this month and are travelling as the Duke and Duchess of Scania.

label: text
text: The Crown Prince, who is 43 years of age, has had a military training of considerable duration in accordance with long established tradition and holds the rank of Major-General. He is also keenly interested in archaeology (as witness the keen interest he has taken in the work of bodies devoted to the study in Peking where he was recently entertained); in agriculture, athletics and physical culture enterprises and exhibitions.

label: text
text:
"Most Christian Prince."
The Prince has inherited a religious temperament from his grandmother, Queen Sophia, and from an uncle, Prince Oscar Bernadotte, who renounced his rights to the throne in order to marry one of his mother's ladies-in-waiting. This religious temperament found expression in an address at the closing session of the Universal Conference on Christian Life and Work at Stockholm—an address which earned for him the title of a modern "Most Christian Prince."

label: text
text: The Prince has long been an active figure among Swedish athletes being the first Royal person to gain the distinction of winning the Swedish so-called "Idrotts-market", an honour conferred on those who successfully fulfil a certain number of tests in different branches of sport.

label: text
text: The Crown Prince of Sweden's first wife was Princess Margaret of Connaught, daughter of Prince Arthur of Connaught, granddaughter of Queen Victoria of Great Britain and elder sister of Princess Patricia of Connaught, known in Canada and elsewhere as "Princess Pat."

label: text
text: During the winter season of 1904-05 they met at a dinner in Cairo, given by the Khedive of Egypt, the engagement was announced the following February and they were married at Windsor Castle in June, 1905. After a short illness Crown Princess Margaret died in May, 1920.

label: text
text: In November, 1923, the Crown Prince was married in London for the second time to Lady Louise Alexandra Marie Irene, daughter of Prince Louis of Battenberg, ranking admiral of the British navy at the outbreak of the war and later created Marquis of Milford Haven by H.M. King George. Her mother is Princess Victoria of Hesse, a sister of the late Empress Alexandra of Russia and a daughter of Princess Alice, Queen Victoria's oldest and favourite child. The Crown Princess is thus a first cousin of Queen Victoria of Spain. Her brother, Lord Louis Mountbatten, accompanied the Prince of Wales on his visit to Japan in 1922.

label: text
text: During the war Crown Princess Louise served as a nurse in a French military hospital. Her father being a naval officer, she was brought up in the traditions of the British navy. Her popularity as the future Queen of Sweden has already been assured.
